title: Vivumishi Vimilikishi (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the possessive the prefix of the thing owned (not of the owner) and the stem of the owner (-angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao).
steps: Find the thing owned and its class.
Join class prefix and owner stem.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "figo yangu" and "figo zetu".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu ___ kimepotea." Kwa nini "wangu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi kimilikishi hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachomilikiwa, si ya mwenye kitu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Vitabu ___ viko mezani." Kwa nini "chenu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitu kikiwa wengi, kivumishi hubadilika: kitabu changu, vitabu vyangu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sisi tunapenda shule ___." Kwa nini "yangu" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Kimilikishi hupatana na kitu kinachomilikiwa: kitabu changu.
